_comment: Voice Activity Detection + engine settings. 'engine': 'auto' = offline whisper.cpp first with local transformers.js Whisper fallback | 'whisper' = whisper.cpp only, no fallback | 'whisper-js' = in-process transformers.js Whisper only. whisperModel: 'tiny' | 'base' (default — best Hindi+English accuracy/speed balance on 8 GB CPU-only machines) | 'small' (best accuracy, ~3x slower on CPU). whisperAutoDownload: downloads the whisper.cpp runtime + GGML model ONCE on first launch, then fully offline forever. Set whisperModelPath / whisperExecutable to use a manually installed model or binary. Lower silenceRmsThreshold = more sensitive (picks up quieter speech). Increase minAudioSamples to require longer utterances.
